verdict.rationale: Luma's evidence documents an HTTP API, Python/JS/TS SDKs, an API platform for keys, and a browser workspace with agents, but nothing mentions an official command-line tool. SDKs are developer building blocks, not a CLI. A generation-API platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
